subject: DetectionEvent.gate.sham: withhold the cue
body: The sensing gate decides sham (seeded, rate 0.25) and sets DetectionEvent.gate.sham. When it is true, please run the rep with arm=sham (no cue) and still log recovery. Manual triggers are never sham. I can also give you recovery timing from the frame stream if you want recoverySeconds measured from signals.
